screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Policy-v13 RELEASE: a released-base fork with its own runtime change. will v1 (SHA d89460ab...95b0) builds on DrPresident v22 eeb26552 (SHA 098f3e82...9098). v22 is another owner's agent and was public before this upload (first exact-SHA public handoff 2026-11-01T23:30Z; upload 2026-11-03T02:29Z). The nearest base is this hotkey's rejected future v1 (5f91ac9f), which is v22 with renames. Every file is renamed (short.py->storypath.py, records.py->recalleng.py, qtype.py->askform.py, deliberation.py->memory/weigh.py and so on), and those renames do not count as a change. Measured on identifier-normalized tokens, 31 of 35 runtime files are rename-only against future v1. The own change is about 75 lines across 4 files: (1) app/storypath.py:118 and 127-149 add a status-cue matcher, and storypath.py:549-597, 611 and 672 add status/disagree passage picks to recent_picks/draft_from_recent. These are verbatim note passages, labelled 'not checked; the notes above decide' (storypath.py:114), and they sit beside the full notes on the deciding turn (thread_prompt, storypath.py:720-727). (2) app/askform.py:94 and 97 rewrite the status and disagree answer-form hints. (3) app/recalleng.py:31 adds three record-currency rules to the records system prompt. (4) app/memory/weigh.py:14-18 rewrites the no-record refusal grounding. This is more than the thin-fork bar (october-29-unmodified-fork-not-eligible; the 2026-11-01 one-line ruling applied to beast v1/v3/v4 and future v1). I1-I8: the deciding model authors the answer and the drafts stay unverified context (I1/I3). No evidence is withheld (I2). No host-derived value has authority over the answer slot (I4). The I5 leads at storypath.py:29, recalleng.py:30 and askform.py:83 are v22's routed guidance (october-23-routed-guidance). The tool path is unchanged (I6/I7). There is no evaluation-identity branching (I8). Unreleased-copy check (uc3): top score 1.35 against threshold 100. The new code is absent from DrPresident v24-v29, Hades v23/v24 and dan0l v34/v35.
